profile.headline: Software Engineer at Discogs
profile.summary:
Unix user since 1995:
• Proficient in Solaris, AIX, Linux (CentOS/Ubuntu) and FreeBSD environments. Also very comfortable in Microsoft Windows and Mac OSX environments.
• System Administration experience in Unix environment.
• AWS (Certified Developer - Associate)
• Azure
• DigitalOcean
• Docker
• Google Cloud Platform
• Kubernetes

Programming Languages:
• Proficient in C/C++, Perl, PHP, and Python.
• Thrives in Unix shell environment: Bourne/Bash/Korn/Zsh/C Shell scripting, Awk/Sed, etc.
• Microsoft environment: PowerShell, Boxstarter, Chocolatey
• Web development: HTML5, JavaScript (jQuery, AngularJs, React, Vue) CSS (LESS, SASS, Compass,) GraphQL, XML.
 • LAMP/MEAN stack
 • Drupal, WordPress, Django, Symfony, Laravel
 • Salesforce, ExactTarget
 • ASP.NET / MVC
• Knowledge of Java, Visual Basic, Tcl/Tk, Squeak/SmallTalk, Pascal, ML, Ruby and x86 assembly.

Database:
• SQL language proficiency with MySQL and PostgreSQL administration experience.
• Some experimentation with MongoDB, and Redis.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented the "My Account" area client side AngularJS application, integrating it with the underlying Drupal site, and a 3rd party ticketing system.
- Provide bug fixes, and maintenance for multiple client sites (Drupal, CakePHP, WordPress, ASP.NET, Laravel, Django etc.)

positions.title: Programmer (Hostbaby.com)
positions.description:
- Part of a team that designed, implemented and maintained (following Agile principles) the entire product line at Hostbaby, including:
-- ATS (Advanced Templating System, a custom easy to use CMS targeted at musicians.)
-- ListBaby (Mailing list manager.)
-- Hostbaby.com (Client portal.)
- Designed and implemented the ATS Theme Editor (jQuery) that allow live editing of the look and feel of the public-facing CMS.
- Designed and implemented a custom deployment system (Makefile/bash/rsync)
- Advocated for, spearheaded and implemented the switchover from SVN to Git of entire 10+ years of organization code base.
- Part of a team that maintained Virtual Ubuntu-based LAMP servers, including both MySQL and PostgreSQL databases.

positions.title: Digital Delivery Lead/Supervisor
positions.description:
- Responsible for running weekly output of music for upload to partner companies such as iTunes, Napster and Rhapsody.
- Coordinated encoding of all new music submissions to various digital formats (such as MP3, AAC, WMA, etc.)
- Created, maintained and modified output and metadata (XML) creation scripts for digital distribution partners.
- Trained digital delivery team.

positions.title: Customer Service Representative (Hostbaby.com)
positions.description:
- Provided email and phone support to web hosting customers.
- Duties also included:
  - light Unix (FreeBSD) system administration,
  - fixing HTML/CSS bugs
  - installation of CMS software for customers.
- Developed custom reminder program for internal use.

positions.title: Lead Programmer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented database back end to web pages, primarily using PHP and Perl to interface with MySQL and PostgreSQL database systems.
- Duties also includes maintaining and administrating the MySQL and PostgreSQL databases (user/database creation, backups.)
- Other responsibilities included light Unix system administration duties such as evaluating and installing software packages.
